# Anushka: The Humanoid

> Anushka is India's humanoid robot, capable of face, object and gesture
> recognition and multilingual speech interaction. She was designed and
> built by Piyush Khanna and Team31, his team, over four years.

Creator: Piyush Khanna (https://piyushkhanna.space/)
Permanent home: https://piyushkhanna.space/project/anushka
This site (anushkathehumanoid.com) is Anushka's original site; the
piyushkhanna.space page above is her current, actively maintained home.

## Capabilities

- 64+ hand gestures
- 20+ eye expressions
- 120+ languages spoken and recognized, offline
- Home automation: controls fans, lights and other appliances
- Autonomous calling system: places phone calls and sends messages on
  her own
- Decision-making modeled on Vedic philosophy of the human mind
  (Chitta, Manas, Ahankaram, Buddhi)
